embeds.title: :loofary: Welcome to the Game Guide
embeds.description:
This guide set is a **work in progress**. It covers every game mode and system, plus *why* certain decisions are made — so you can learn the reasoning and make your own calls for your specific situation.

**What's covered**
:Settings: Legend: icons, currencies & stats
:Power: Main Stage • :Play: Play Stage • :Money: Money Upgrades
:Gun: Guns • :Skin: Skins • :Mission: Missions
:Rebirth: Rebirth (Stage 3) • :Diamond: Mine (Stage 4) • :Fish: Fish (Stage 6)
:Boss: Boss (Stage 10) • :Hunt: Hunt (Stage 12) • :Pet: Pets (Stage 12)
:Trip: Trips (Stage 35) • :Raid: Raid (Stage 40)
:Diamond: Earning Diamonds • Diamond Spending Guide
:Money: Real Money Purchases • Whale Spending Guide

Use the **📖 Guides Index** post or `/guide` to jump to any section.
Got questions? Check the [📖 FAQs](https://discord.com/channels/1541040609534410762/1553012405217398864/1553012451073589349).

embeds.title: Menus (top left corner)
embeds.description:
:Settings: **Settings:** Save and load files, contact support and adjust sound/vibrations.
:Daily: **Daily Login:** A bonus every day you log in; resets after 7 days.
:Trophy: **Leaderboard:** See how your max Main Stage compares with everyone else. Try to reach the **Top 30**!

embeds.title: :Power: Main Stage
embeds.description:
Defeat the trees within **3 minutes** and climb Stages to unlock content and top the leaderboard.

**How Stages work**
Each Stage has **5 Substages**: `1-1 → 1-2 → 1-3 → 1-4 → 1-5 → 2-1`. Every few Stages the tree design changes — this is purely cosmetic.

**Tree types**
There are 3 types of trees: **A**, **B** and **C**. B and C trees have roughly **2x** and **3x** more health. Higher Substages have more trees in total and more B & C trees, so you'll usually fail somewhere between Substage 3 and 5. Tree health does **not** change between Substages.

**Golden Tree**
At the end of Substage 5 there's a Golden Tree with far more health than regular trees. Defeat it in time to move on to the next Stage, where tree health increases.

fields.name: 💡 When to push vs. Rebirth
fields.value:
Push your highest Stage before Rebirthing — it increases your :Rebirth: Rebirth Gems, which snowballs your growth. A quick check: if the progress bar is past **50%** before the timer hits halfway, you can clear it.

**Active play:** It may be more efficient to Rebirth once a Substage takes ~50% of the timer. If it takes 1 hour to get back to Max Stage and 15 minutes of slow clearing only gives +5% Rebirth Gems, Rebirth earlier and more often.

**Mostly idle:** Definitely push your max Stage so you claim bigger rewards when you come back.

embeds.title: :Play: Play Stage
embeds.description:
You have **1 minute** to clear the trees. Beating the 1st stage unlocks :Gun: **Guns** and reveals the rest of the unlockable content.

:Money: **Upgrades DO carry over** into this mode, so do these Stages while you're at your Max Stage with your highest Upgrades.

You should be able to clear the same Play Stage as your Max Stage.

**Reward:** 120 :Diamond: per Stage (with ads).

[📖 FAQs](https://discord.com/channels/1541040609534410762/1553012405217398864/1553012499446763603)

embeds.title: :Money: Money Upgrades
embeds.description:
You earn :Money: Money by destroying trees in the Main Stage. It's spent on 3 upgrades: :Power: **Power**, :Speed: **ATK SPD** and :Money: **Money**.

⚠️ These upgrades **RESET** when you Rebirth.

**Priority:** :Power: Power → :Money: Money → :Speed: ATK SPD

fields.name: 💡 Quick-upgrade trick
fields.value: Instead of holding your finger down, **Save** the game (:Settings: top left), force-quit the app and come back in 1–2 minutes. Your Money Upgrades will automatically max out to the highest level you can afford.

embeds.title: :Gun: Guns
embeds.description:
Summon and merge Guns with :Diamond:. There are **5 types** of gun, each behaving differently.

You can equip **3 guns**: you control the cat in slot 1, and the other 2 create cats that follow you around.

fields.name: :Blast: Which gun is best?
fields.value:
**Blast** is currently the best for Main Stages (both climbing back up and pushing max stage), and **Pierce** for Bosses.

However, **always merge when you can** — the power gain far outweighs any small boost between gun types of the same tier.

fields.name: :Diamond: Mine exception
fields.value: Blast is the best weapon in the Mine. It can be worth keeping **3x of your lowest-ranked Blasts** to maximise Mine rewards.

fields.name: 🔒 Lock
fields.value: Lock a Gun to prevent accidentally merging it.

fields.name: 🗄️ Vault
fields.value: Store extra weapons here to make merging in your inventory easier. Extra slots can be bought with :Diamond:.

embeds.title: :Skin: Skins
embeds.description:
Cosmetic Skins for your cats that also give a buff!

You **don't** need to wear a Skin to get its bonus. Once purchased, it always provides its :Power: Power, :Speed: ATK SPD and :Money: Money boost.

[📖 FAQs](https://discord.com/channels/1541040609534410762/1553012405217398864/1553012506878808135)

embeds.title: :Mission: Missions
embeds.description:
Complete Daily Missions to earn points toward **Season rewards**.

• F2P players can earn **200 points/day** — enough to finish a Season in **13 days** (averaging ~12 days long-term).
• Each Season has a **30-day** time limit.
• Once you finish a Season you can **start a new one**, so completing all your daily missions earns rewards faster.

fields.name: 💡 Best VIP Pack to buy
fields.value: The **first** Season gives :Gun: Guns as bonuses between :Diamond: rewards. Between updates these change from Guns to :Star: Stars — so if you're a spender, the VIP Pack for the 1st Season (with guns) is the most valuable VIP Pack you'll buy.

embeds.title: :Rebirth: Rebirth — Unlocks at Stage 3
embeds.description: Once you reach Stage **3-1** you can Rebirth. This resets your Upgrades and sends you back to Stage 1-1, but gives you :Rebirth: **Rebirth Gems** to buy **PERMANENT** upgrades. The higher your Max Stage, the more Rebirth Gems you get.

fields.name: 📊 Power : Money cost ratio
fields.value:
• Highest Upgrades at Max Stage **below Lv5000** → **5 : 1**
• Highest Upgrades at Max Stage **above Lv5000** → **8 : 1**

Example: if your :Money: Money upgrade costs **20a**, your :Power: Power upgrade should cost about **100a**. This gives roughly equal power gains from both.

:Speed: Upgrade Speed evenly with Money *(to be tested)* until **Lv600–Lv1000**, then stop.

fields.name: ⚠️ Early-game caveat
fields.value: When you don't yet have high-level Guns/Skins/Fish, leaning into :Power: Power can be better for :Boss: Boss fights — more :Diamond: for a fast boost in Guns/Skins/Fish. This benefit shrinks as you collect more of them; where it stops being worth it varies a lot. If you've bought **2x Boss Rewards**, focusing Power matters more.

fields.name: :Speed: ATK SPD hard cap
fields.value:
Gun ATK SPD has a **hard cap** — past it, extra upgrades do nothing. The author hit it around **Lv1000** (exact point unknown); another player hit it at **Lv300** with a Z Gun.

**How to test:** Fight the Boss until you lose and note its health; repeat twice for an average. Rebirth, put all points into ATK SPD and fight again. If your damage doesn't change, you've hit the cap — put all future Rebirth Gems into Power and Money.

fields.name: 🎬 3x Rebirth
fields.value:
• **Ad 3x Rebirth:** once a day, refreshes at midnight.
• **Paid 3x Rebirth:** unlocks at Main Stage 100 after using the Ad 3x Rebirth; also refreshes at midnight.

fields.name: 📉 Lv15000 slowdown
fields.value: At Rebirth **Lv15000**, the cost of each upgrade jumps **100–200x**, so progress slows dramatically.

embeds.title: :Diamond: Mine — Unlocks at Stage 4
embeds.description:
Destroy all the stones in **60 seconds** to earn :Diamond:, but your weapon only does **1 damage**.

• **2 free entries per day** — up to **6** with the Mine Pack purchase.
• Max **190 gems** per run: blue stones give **1**, grey stones give **0.1**.
• Upgrades DO carry over, but this only matters if you haven't hit the :Speed: ATK SPD cap from Rebirth Upgrades.
• Damage is always 1, so **weapon type matters more than damage** — :Blast: **Blast** is currently best.

fields.name: 🌀 Strategy
fields.value:
You won't clear every gem at first. Going in a **spiral from the inside out** is the most efficient route.

• **Never go back** for a couple of missed stones — you lose more time than they're worth.
• Gravitate toward **blue stones** as you spiral.
• Keep your whole screen filled with stones as often as possible.

embeds.title: :Fish: Fish — Unlocks at Stage 6
embeds.description:
Summon and merge Fish for :Power: Power, :CritRate: Crit Chance and :CritDamage: Crit Damage boosts. You get **5 free summons a day**.

Fish are the **only source of Crit Chance**. Once you get an **SS Fish** you'll be landing crits almost 100% of the time — a massive damage boost.

Tap a fish to see its grade; you can also view fish you haven't unlocked yet.

💰 A **C Rank Fish** costs **125 :Diamond:** on average (from the 200-gem summon odds).

[📖 FAQs](https://discord.com/channels/1541040609534410762/1553012405217398864/1553012515716341883)

embeds.title: :Boss: Boss — Unlocks at Stage 10
embeds.description:
Defeat the moving boss in **60 seconds**.

:Money: Upgrades **DO NOT** carry over, so play whenever suits you. This is a very good source of :Diamond: (**450/Stage**), so push these stages as often as possible.

**Early on:** Anticipate the boss's movements and follow it manually. Once you have enough :Movement: Movement Speed from Pets and Trip Abilities, you can use **autoplay** and focus on damage.

fields.name: 💡 When to stop
fields.value: Boss health increases **5x each level**. If you beat a boss with **less than 48 seconds** left, don't bother attempting the next one — you won't have enough damage.

embeds.title: :Hunt: Hunt — Unlocks at Stage 12
embeds.description:
Defeat the slimes before they reach the circle. Advance through the Substages and climb the Stages to rank on the leaderboards.

:Money: Money Upgrades **DO NOT** carry over, so play whenever suits you. Every Substage cleared rewards :Hunt: **Hunt Gems** for Pet Summons.

⏱️ Stages take a while (~**2.5 minutes per Stage**), but each level **auto-plays** — leave your phone and come back when you fail to collect all the rewards.

[📖 FAQs](https://discord.com/channels/1541040609534410762/1553012405217398864/1553012520690913321)

embeds.title: :Pet: Pets — Unlocks at Stage 12
embeds.description: Summon and merge Pets with :Hunt: Hunt Gems or :Diamond:. Pets give a :Money: Money and :Movement: Movement Speed boost.

fields.name: 🎯 Goal: 3x XXX Pets
fields.value: Work toward **3x XXX Pets** and level them up **evenly**. Merge a 4th pet in your inventory, then merge that into your main pets.

fields.name: ⚠️ Don't merge your main 3 together
fields.value:
Pet level affects your **offline idle clear rate** and :Trip: **Trip Gem rewards**, and both increase **linearly** per level. Going from D → C gives the same *extra* gems/offline speed as XX → XXX.

If you merge two main pets, your 3rd pet starts again at D — you'd actually **lose** Trip Gem rewards and offline speed.

fields.name: ➡️ After 3x XXX
fields.value: Level up **another 3x XXX** evenly for Trips — you'll have spare :Trip: Wings from only doing 16-hour Trips.

embeds.title: :Trip: Trips — Unlocks at Stage 35
embeds.description:
Send your pets on Trips to earn Ability Gems and upgrade **Abilities** for unique bonuses.

**Locations:** :Green: Forest, :Orange: Desert and :Blue: Glacier. Only **one** is open each day — except **Sunday**, when all three are.

Start by sending 1 pet on a 1-hour Trip for EXP and that location's gems. Pets on a Trip **can't be merged**. As your Trip level rises you unlock longer Trips and can send up to **3 pets** at once.

fields.name: :Trip: Wings
fields.value:
Sending 1 pet costs **1 :Trip: Wing, regardless of Trip length** — so your longest available Trip is always the most efficient.

Capacity is **20**, regenerating **1 every 4 hours**. Waiting is the only way to get more.

fields.name: 📋 Trip plan
fields.value:
1. Only do the **longest Trip** until you unlock the next longest; repeat until you can do **16-hour Trips with 3 pets**.
2. With Wings regenerating every 4h, you'll have ~**1 spare Wing per 16h Trip**. Save these for :Green: **Forest** days and run **8-hour Trips**.
3. **End goal:** always have a 16h Trip running, and on Forest days *also* run 8h Trips until your spare Wings are used — keep enough for your next 16h Trip.

fields.name: :Green: Why Forest?
fields.value: Forest adds :Power: **Power AND :Rebirth: Rebirth** bonuses (which boost power further). The other locations add Idle Time and Movement Speed, which don't directly increase power.

fields.name: :Star: Trip Abilities
fields.value: Summon Trip Abilities with your Trip Gems — you get a random ability of that colour. Lv1 needs **2 copies** to upgrade; this rises by 2 each level and caps at **50 copies at Lv25**. Max level is **51**. Bonuses scale linearly, so higher levels get less efficient.

embeds.title: :Raid: Raid — Unlocks at Stage 40
embeds.description:
Deal as much damage as you can to a huge stationary slime in **60 seconds**. Each time you deplete a health bar, a new one with **2.5x** more health appears.

:Rebirth: Rebirth and :Money: Money upgrades **DO NOT** apply, making :Gun: Guns, :Skin: Skins, :Fish: Fish and :Star: Trip Abilities more important.

fields.name: 📅 Weekly & daily
fields.value:
• Each week a different gun type deals **10x damage** (order follows the Gun Codex).
• Weekly missions give extra :RaidGem: Raid Gems.
• **2 free attempts/day**, +1 with ads, +1 paid.

fields.name: :RaidGem: Raid Gems & Gun Slots
fields.value:
The more damage you do, the more Raid Gems you get. Use them to upgrade each of your **3 Gun Slots** up to **Lv20**, each level boosting damage.

💡 Most efficient: **focus one slot until it's Lv20.**

fields.name: 🎲 Upgrade odds
fields.value:
Success chance drops and cost rises with each successful upgrade.
• **Lv1:** 50 Raid Gems — 100% chance
• **Lv20:** 1000 Raid Gems — 1% chance

embeds.title: :Money: Real Money Purchases Guide
embeds.description:
This game has microtransactions — expected for a free mobile game. Some purchases are decent value; some are very expensive and not worth it. If you plan to play long term, **No Reward Ads is almost a requirement** unless FOMO doesn't affect you at all.

Ratings are out of 10 with prices in **AUD**.

fields.name: ⭐ 10/10 — No Reward Ads ($14.99)
fields.value: Should be your **1st purchase**; if it's your only one, you've unlocked most of the content without the hassle. Also gives a 🐷 piggy bank earning **1 :Diamond:/min** (cap 500).

fields.name: ⭐ 9/10 — 4+ Extra Mine Entries ($9.99)
fields.value: Next best. Each Mine with ads gives **760 :Diamond:** — that's **3,040 extra gems/day, forever**.

fields.name: 6/10 — Bonus Reward Package 7 Days ($12.99)
fields.value: Double Hunt & Boss rewards and 1.5x Mine rewards. Great head start for :Diamond: and :Hunt: Hunt Gems; gets less efficient as your Fish and Guns improve. Value drops fast after 1–2 buys.

fields.name: 6/10 — No Forced Ads ($4.99)
fields.value: Mainly for the extra **1 gem/min** that stacks with No Reward Ads. In theory 1,440/day, but with the 500 cap you'll lose some while sleeping — about **950/day** extra, and you'll need to check every **4 hours** instead of 8.

fields.name: 5/10 — VIP Pass ($12.99)
fields.value: Great value but must be bought **every Season**. Cuts Seasons from 12 to **9 days**. Over **40K :Diamond:** and **10K :Star: Star Gems** (or 35K worth of guns). Next best buy if you have the budget.

fields.name: 5/10 — Autoupgrade ($12.99)
fields.value: Useful if your phone is always on. At higher levels your online clear rate is ~**2.5x** your offline rate — it's a choice between idle and active play.

fields.name: 3/10 — VVIP Pass ($22.99)
fields.value: Finish the Season in **5 days**, but same rewards as VIP.

fields.name: 3/10 — Convenience Package 7 Days ($9.99)
fields.value: Skip Hunt & Play Stages, skip Trip wait times, Auto Merge. Quality of life; best paired with the Bonus Reward Package.

fields.name: 3/10 — 3x Rebirth ($2.99)
fields.value: Triples Rebirth Gems an extra time per day. Only worth it at high stages when reaching Max Stage takes hours. Gets expensive daily.

fields.name: 1/10 — Buff Pack ($12.99)
fields.value: With No Reward Ads you can just tap the boost button for x3 Power, Speed and Money. Only use: paired with Autoupgrade to AFK-push — maybe 1–2 extra Stages.

fields.name: 1/10 — Diamond Purchases ($2.99–$79.99)
fields.value: A dismal amount of gems compared to VIP. Instant, but this game is long-term — invest elsewhere.

fields.name: 1/10 — Step Purchases & Weekly Shop Guns
fields.value: Objectively horrible value. If you want to spend a lot, permanent VVIP Passes are far better value.

fields.name: 1/10 — Trip Daily/Weekly Deals ($5.99–$39.99)
fields.value: For the cost of a VIP Pass you get 1,750 :Star: Star Gems — **less** than one 16h Trip with 3x XXX Pets, and barely a level once abilities pass Lv15.

fields.name: 1/10 — Time Package 7 Days ($7.99)
fields.value: Roughly doubles Power for Boss & Play Stages, but 2x Power is easy to get elsewhere, and it slows Main Stage progress.

fields.name: 1/10 — Raid Mission Pass ($7.99) • Enhance Stone Bank ($1.99+) • Raid Ticket ($1.99)
fields.value: F2P can hit a Lv20 Enhance in **4–7 days**; these only save a couple of days. (Stone Bank: 5/week. Ticket: 1/day.)

fields.name: 1/10 — Helper Package ($5.99)
fields.value: Useless: the Helper's Enhance level matches your **lowest** slot, so a Lv20 Helper needs 3x Lv20 slots already. +33% power = 1 extra stage at best.

embeds.title: :Money: Whale Spending Guide
embeds.description: For players with **no spending limit** — this changes how you approach the game vs. F2P or low spenders. There are still bad purchases, so costs are shown as **$ per 1 Day's Progress** to help you judge whether saving time is worth it. Prices in AUD.

fields.name: ⭐ 10/10 — No Reward Ads ($14.99)
fields.value: Still the best purchase: 2x–3x rewards.

fields.name: ⭐ 10/10 — 3x Rebirth ($2.99)
fields.value: The only way to pass top players who don't buy it. Buying this **on top of** efficient play beats anyone who isn't. Expensive to maintain.

fields.name: ⭐ 10/10 — Bonus Reward Package 7 Days ($12.99)
fields.value: Huge for catching up. Loses value after 2 buys — you'll have ZZZ Gun and ZZZ Fish by the end of week 2.

fields.name: ⭐ 10/10 — Convenience Package 7 Days ($9.99)
fields.value: Huge for catching up and doing pets efficiently. Loses value after 2 buys — you should have 3x XXX Pets by then.

fields.name: 9/10 — 4+ Extra Mine Entries ($9.99)
fields.value: Permanent daily :Diamond: boost. 💡 On the last day of a Season use only **2** Mine tickets, so the extras complete a whole new day of the next Season.

fields.name: 9/10 — Autoupgrade ($12.99)
fields.value: Makes active pushing far easier — and you'll do a lot of it to catch up.

fields.name: 9/10 — VVIP Pass ($22.99)
fields.value: 5-day Seasons plus extra bonuses. Keep it running until ZZZ Gun and Fish, then drop it or downgrade to VIP.

fields.name: 9/10 — Trip Daily/Weekly Deals ($5.99–$39.99)
fields.value:
Only useful very early, before you have much Skip %. The **6000** pack gets everything to Lv5 (30% total Skip). A XXX Pet on a 16h Trip gives 608 gems; x6/day ≈ 3,608/day.
• 750 = $29 / day
• 1750 = $27 / day
• 6000 = $24 / day

fields.name: 8/10 — VIP Pass ($12.99)
fields.value: 9-day Seasons plus bonuses; next best if VVIP is too expensive.

fields.name: 6/10 — No Forced Ads ($4.99)
fields.value: Small permanent boost to daily gems.

fields.name: 5/10 — Raid Mission Pass • Enhance Stone Bank • Raid Ticket
fields.value:
Cuts a Lv20 Enhance Slot from 4–7 days down to ~1. Cheap, so useful if pushing hard.
• $18 / 3 days — Pass + Ticket + Stone Bank Lv1 x2 + Lv2 x1
• $10 / 2 days — Pass + Ticket
• $8 / 1 day — Pass

fields.name: 1. Rebirth ratio
fields.value: With 2x Rewards and Instant Clear you can drop the 5:1 Power:Money cost ratio and lean harder into :Power: Power to clear more Boss and Hunt Stages. Around Z Gun and Z Fish, move back toward **5:1**, as the next tier costs far more.

fields.name: 2. Pet merging
fields.value: Instant Trips mean Wings won't overflow, so rush a **single** pet to XXX for max Trip rewards, then level the other 2 evenly (merging via inventory) for Movement Speed.

fields.name: 3. Trips
fields.value: Use only **1 pet** on the longest Trips until 16h unlocks. Get **Lv15 Skip Stage** in all locations (90% Skip) — Star Packs speed this up. Then focus purely on :Green: Forest for the last 10% Skip, and aim for **Lv51 Rebirth**.

fields.name: 🏁 Goals
fields.value:
**1. 100% Skip Stage** — maximises your active clear rate so you can catch up on the biggest time-gated mechanic: Rebirthing.
**2. ZZZ Gun & ZZZ Fish** — after this :Diamond: lose most of their value; consider dropping 2x Rewards and VVIP → VIP or nothing. A 400K ZZZ Gun only gives 2x power; the 3rd is 1.5x. Same for Fish.
**3. Rebirth efficiently & frequently** — money isn't a free pass to the Top 30. Use 3x :Blast: Blasts, paid Super Rebirths and the 5:1 → 8:1 ratio to climb.
